overview.businessScope: Il modello raccoglie dati su Jira, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Confluence e Service Desk, collegandoli ad APM, progetti, utenti e dati HR; include inoltre iniziative, richieste, funzionalità, delivery e test. measures.name: DEBUG num KPI2
measures.expression:
VAR T_JMBI_ICT =
CALCULATETABLE(
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        'Jira Macro Business Initiative',
        "IM_norm", 'Jira Macro Business Initiative'[Issue Investment Memo]
    ),
    'Jira Project List'[Project_Status] <> "Demo Project",
    TREATAS(VALUES('GDS_Line'[ICT_lvl_1]), 'Jira Macro Business Initiative'[Projectrak GDS Line]),
    TREATAS(VALUES('GDS_Line'[ICT_lvl_2]), 'Jira Macro Business Initiative'[Projectrak Factory - Chapter])
)

//
// ===== Lista IM approvati =====
//

VAR tab_ICT =
CALCULATETABLE(
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        'Jira Demand',
        "IM_norm", 'Jira Demand'[Issue Investment Memo]
    ),
    KEEPFILTERS('Jira Investment Memo'[Issue_status] = "Approved"),
    TREATAS(VALUES('GDS_Line'[ICT_lvl_1]), 'Jira Business Need'[1st richiedente]),
    TREATAS(VALUES('GDS_Line'[ICT_lvl_2]), 'Jira Business Need'[2nd richiedente])
)

VAR tabella_ICT  = DISTINCT(INTERSECT(T_JMBI_ICT, tab_ICT))

/* ===== Totale costi ===== */

VAR TotaleCosti_ICT =
    CALCULATE (
        SUM ( 'Jira Demand'[Total Cost] ),
        TREATAS ( tabella_ICT, 'Jira Investment Memo'[IM_norm] )
    )

RETURN
COALESCE ( TotaleCosti_ICT, 0 )

DEBUG num KPI3
measures.expression:
VAR Features_Denom =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT(  'Jira Feature Delivery'[Issue Key [Issue]]] ),
        'Jira Feature Delivery'[Issue status] IN {
            "In Progress", "Ready for UAT", "Completed",
            "Release Completed", "UAT Passed"
        },
        'Jira Feature Delivery'[Issue Initiative Type] = "Project",
        'Jira Business Feature'[Projectrak Project Status] <> "Demo Project"
    )

VAR Features_Epic =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT( 'Jira Epic'[feature_delivery] ),
        NOT ISBLANK('Jira Epic'[feature_delivery]),
        'Jira Epic'[feature_delivery] <> "",
        'Jira Project List'[Project_Status] <> "Demo Project"
    )

VAR ValidFeatures =
    INTERSECT( Features_Epic, Features_Denom )

VAR Result =
    CALCULATE(
        COUNTROWS( ValidFeatures ),
        USERELATIONSHIP(
            'Jira Issue Detail'[epiclink],
            'Jira Epic'[issue_key]
        ),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            'Jira Issue Detail'[issue_type_name]
                IN { "Task", "Milestone", "Story" }
        )
    )

RETURN
    COALESCE(Result, 0)

measures.name: ToStatus_MBI
measures.expression:
VAR _Scelta = SELECTEDVALUE(Filtri_grafici_MBI_IE[Misure])
VAR _StringaPath = SUBSTITUTE(_Scelta, " to ", "|")
VAR _Y = PATHITEM(_StringaPath, 2) -- Lo stato di arrivo (es. Estimation Done)

-- Calcoliamo la data massima filtrando per l'ingresso nello stato Y
VAR _DataMassimaY = 
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]),
        ALLEXCEPT('MBI Transition Status', 'MBI Transition Status'[issue_key]),
        'MBI Transition Status'[to_status] = _Y,
        'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] <> _Y -- Evita di prendere aggiornamenti mentre è già in Y
    )

RETURN
    _DataMassimaY

        + (IF(NOT ISBLANK(T3) && T3<>0, 1, 0))

measures.name: Estimation Effort | Status In Progress
measures.expression:
VAR _FullIssue = SELECTEDVALUE('Jira Feature Delivery 2'[Issue])
VAR _SelectedIssue = 
    IF(
        ISBLANK(_FullIssue) || COUNTROWS(VALUES('Jira Feature Delivery 2'[Issue])) > 1,
        BLANK(),  -- più valori in contesto, non calcolare
        IF(
            ISERROR(FIND(" ", _FullIssue)),
            _FullIssue,
            LEFT(_FullIssue, FIND(" ", _FullIssue) - 1)
        )
    )
VAR _EpicKeys = 
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(ALL('Jira Epic'), 'Jira Epic'[feature_delivery] = _SelectedIssue),
        "EpicKey", 'Jira Epic'[issue_key]
    )
VAR _FilteredStories =
    FILTER(
        ALL('Jira Issue Detail 3'),
        'Jira Issue Detail 3'[issue_type_name] IN {"Story", "Task"}
        && 'Jira Issue Detail 3'[epiclink] IN _EpicKeys
    )
VAR _Done = COUNTROWS(FILTER(_FilteredStories, 'Jira Issue Detail 3'[status_category] = "Done"))
VAR _InProgress = COUNTROWS(FILTER(_FilteredStories, 'Jira Issue Detail 3'[status_category] = "In Progress"))
VAR _ToDo = COUNTROWS(FILTER(_FilteredStories, 'Jira Issue Detail 3'[status_category] = "To Do"))
VAR _Total = _Done + _InProgress + _ToDo
VAR _KPI_Raw = DIVIDE((_Done * 1) + (_InProgress * 0.5) + (_ToDo * 0), _Total)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(_SelectedIssue),
        BLANK(),
        IF(
            ISEMPTY(_EpicKeys) || _Total = 0,
            0.26,
            0.26 + (_KPI_Raw * 0.53)
        )
    )

                            < 'IE Transition Status'[From OrdineBarra Semplificato]
                    )
                )

                LOOKUPVALUE(
                    'Jira Initiative Estimation'[issue_status],
                    'Jira Initiative Estimation'[issue_key],
                    'IE Transition Status'[issue_key]
                )
            RETURN
                IF(
                    IsOpen,
                    -- OPEN: from = Open, to = Waiting for Estimate, stato attuale diverso da Open e Rejected
                    'IE Transition Status'[from_status] = "Open"
                    && 'IE Transition Status'[to_status] = "Waiting for Estimate"
                    && StatoAttuale <> "Open"
                    && StatoAttuale <> "Rejected",
                    -- ALTRI STATI: solo in avanti, no Rejected, solo dopo l'ultimo rework
                    'IE Transition Status'[From OrdineBarra Semplificato] = OrdineSelezionato
                    && 'IE Transition Status'[To OrdineBarra Semplificato] > OrdineSelezionato
                    && 'IE Transition Status'[to_status] <> "Rejected"
                    && ( ISBLANK(DataUltimoRework)
                         || 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] > DataUltimoRework )
                )
        )
    )

    ALL('IE Transition Status'[issue_key])

        IsOpen,

            FILTER(
                VALUES('Jira Initiative Estimation'[issue_key]),
                NOT ( 'Jira Initiative Estimation'[issue_key] IN IssueConTransizioni )
            )
        ),
        0
    )

VAR Risultato =
    RisultatoConTransizioni + RisultatoSenzaTransizioni

RETURN
    IF(
        IsSingleIssueSelected && Risultato > 1,
        BLANK(),
        Risultato
    )

measures.expression:
VAR StatusTradotto = SELECTEDVALUE('Workflow Fasi MBI 2'[Status Tradotto])

VAR StatiDellaFase =

        FILTER(

            'Workflow Fasi MBI 2'[Status Tradotto] = StatusTradotto
        )
    )

VAR IsOpen = CONTAINS(StatiDellaFase, 'Workflow Fasi MBI 2'[Status], "Open")

VAR TransizioniUscita =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        SELECTCOLUMNS(
            FILTER(
                ALL('MBI Transition Status'),
                'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] IN StatiDellaFase
                    && NOT('MBI Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase)
                    && 'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] <> 'MBI Transition Status'[to_status]
            ),
            "iu_issue_key", 'MBI Transition Status'[issue_key],
            "iu_data", 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
        )
    )

RETURN
IF(
    IsOpen,
    -- Per Open: conta tutte le issue che hanno almeno una transizione di uscita dalla fase
    COUNTROWS(
        CALCULATETABLE(
            VALUES('MBI Transition Status'[issue_key]),
            FILTER(
                ALL('MBI Transition Status'),
                'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] IN StatiDellaFase
                && NOT('MBI Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase)
                && 'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] <> 'MBI Transition Status'[to_status]
            )
        )
    ),
    -- Per tutti gli altri stati: logica originale con coppia completa
    VAR TransizioniEntrata =
        CALCULATETABLE(
            SELECTCOLUMNS(
                FILTER(
                    ALL('MBI Transition Status'),
                    'MBI Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase
                ),
                "ie_issue_key", 'MBI Transition Status'[issue_key],
                "ie_data", 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
            )
        )
    VAR IssueUscite =
        CALCULATETABLE(
            VALUES('MBI Transition Status'[issue_key]),
            FILTER(
                ADDCOLUMNS(
                    VALUES('MBI Transition Status'[issue_key]),
                    "HasCoppiaCompleta",
                    VAR currentKey = 'MBI Transition Status'[issue_key]
                    VAR entrateIssue = FILTER(TransizioniEntrata, [ie_issue_key] = currentKey)
                    VAR usciteIssue  = FILTER(TransizioniUscita,  [iu_issue_key] = currentKey)
                    RETURN
                        COUNTROWS(
                            FILTER(
                                entrateIssue,
                                VAR dataEntrata = [ie_data]
                                RETURN
                                    COUNTROWS(
                                        FILTER(usciteIssue, [iu_data] > dataEntrata)
                                    ) > 0
                            )
                        ) > 0
                ),
                [HasCoppiaCompleta] = TRUE()
            )
        )
    RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT('MBI Transition Status'[issue_key]),
        FILTER(
            ALL('MBI Transition Status'),
            'MBI Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase
            && 'MBI Transition Status'[issue_key] IN IssueUscite
        )
    )
)

measures.expression:

VAR StatiDellaFase =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES('Workflow Fasi MBI 2'[Status]),
        FILTER(
            ALL('Workflow Fasi MBI 2'),
            'Workflow Fasi MBI 2'[Status Tradotto] = StatusTradotto
        )
    )

VAR IsOpen = CONTAINS(StatiDellaFase, 'Workflow Fasi MBI 2'[Status], "Open")

VAR DataCreazioneOpen =
    CALCULATE(
        MIN('Jira Macro Business Initiative'[Issue Created Date Formatted]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Jira Macro Business Initiative'),
        'Jira Macro Business Initiative'[Issue key] = issueKey
    )

VAR entrateIssue =
    FILTER(
        ALL('MBI Transition Status'),
        'MBI Transition Status'[issue_key] = issueKey
        && 'MBI Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase
        && NOT('MBI Transition Status'[from_status] IN StatiDellaFase)
        && 'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] <> 'MBI Transition Status'[to_status]
    )

VAR usciteIssue =
    FILTER(
        ALL('MBI Transition Status'),
        'MBI Transition Status'[issue_key] = issueKey
        && 'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] IN StatiDellaFase
        && NOT('MBI Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase)
        && 'MBI Transition Status'[from_status] <> 'MBI Transition Status'[to_status]
    )

VAR primaUscitaOpen =
    MINX(usciteIssue, 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date])

VAR giorniOpen =
    VAR primaEntrata = 
        IF(
            NOT ISBLANK(DataCreazioneOpen) && DataCreazioneOpen <= primaUscitaOpen,
            DataCreazioneOpen,
            primaUscitaOpen
        )
    VAR primaSoggiorno =
        IF(
            NOT ISBLANK(primaEntrata) && NOT ISBLANK(primaUscitaOpen) && primaEntrata < primaUscitaOpen,
            DATEDIFF(primaEntrata, primaUscitaOpen, DAY),
            0
        )
    VAR soggiorniSuccessivi =
        SUMX(
            FILTER(
                entrateIssue,
                VAR dataEntrata = 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
                RETURN COUNTROWS(
                    FILTER(usciteIssue, 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata)
                ) > 0
            ),
            VAR dataEntrata = 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
            VAR primaUscitaSucc =
                MINX(
                    FILTER(usciteIssue, 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata),
                    'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
                )
            RETURN DATEDIFF(dataEntrata, primaUscitaSucc, DAY)
        )
    RETURN primaSoggiorno + soggiorniSuccessivi

VAR giorniAltriStati =
    SUMX(
        FILTER(
            entrateIssue,
            VAR dataEntrata = 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
            RETURN COUNTROWS(
                FILTER(usciteIssue, 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata)
            ) > 0
        ),
        VAR dataEntrata = 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
        VAR primaUscita =
            MINX(
                FILTER(usciteIssue, 'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata),
                'MBI Transition Status'[transition_date]
            )
        RETURN DATEDIFF(dataEntrata, primaUscita, DAY)
    )

RETURN
IF(IsOpen, giorniOpen, giorniAltriStati)

        && NOT('BF Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase)

calculatedColumns.name: Lead Time - OpenDone
calculatedColumns.expression:
-- data primo ingresso in Open (from_status = "Open")
VAR _startDate = 
    CALCULATE (
        MIN ( 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] ),
        ALLEXCEPT ( 'IE Transition Status', 'IE Transition Status'[issue_key] ),
        'IE Transition Status'[from_status] = "Open"
    )

-- data dell'ultima transizione verso Done
VAR _lastDate = 
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] ),
        ALLEXCEPT ( 'IE Transition Status', 'IE Transition Status'[issue_key] ),
        'IE Transition Status'[to_status] = "Done",
        'IE Transition Status'[from_status] <> "Done"
    )

-- Controlla se dopo l'ultima Done la issue è uscita dallo stato Done
-- (es. Done -> Open, Done → Estimation Approval, ecc., in questo caso non la conto più)
-- (es. Open .. -> Done, Done -> Done non viene considerata)
VAR _hasExitAfterLastDone =
    CALCULATE (
        COUNTROWS ( 'IE Transition Status' ),
        ALLEXCEPT ( 'IE Transition Status', 'IE Transition Status'[issue_key] ),
        'IE Transition Status'[from_status] = "Done",
        'IE Transition Status'[to_status] <> "Done",
        'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] > _lastDate
    )

-- Restituisce il lead time solo se:
-- 1. La riga corrente è una transizione verso Done
-- 2. È l'ultima transizione verso Done
-- 3. Esiste una data di partenza da Open
-- 4. La issue NON è uscita da Done dopo l'ultima volta
RETURN 
IF ( 
    'IE Transition Status'[to_status] = "Done" 
        && 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] = _lastDate
        && NOT ISBLANK ( _startDate ),
        //&& ( ISBLANK ( _hasExitAfterLastDone ) || _hasExitAfterLastDone = 0 ),
    'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] - _startDate,
    BLANK()
)

calculatedColumns.name: Somma dei tempi nello stato IE
calculatedColumns.expression:
VAR StatusTradotto = SELECTEDVALUE('Workflow Fasi IE 2'[Status Tradotto])
VAR issueKey = SELECTEDVALUE('IE Transition Status'[issue_key])

VAR StatiDellaFase =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES('Workflow Fasi IE 2'[Status]),
        FILTER(
            ALL('Workflow Fasi IE 2'),
            'Workflow Fasi IE 2'[Status Tradotto] = StatusTradotto
        )
    )

VAR IsOpen = CONTAINS(StatiDellaFase, 'Workflow Fasi IE 2'[Status], "Open")

VAR DataCreazioneOpen =
    CALCULATE(
        MIN('Jira Initiative Estimation'[issue_start_date]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Jira Initiative Estimation'),
        'Jira Initiative Estimation'[issue_key] = issueKey
    )

VAR entrateIssue =
    FILTER(
        ALL('IE Transition Status'),
        'IE Transition Status'[issue_key] = issueKey
        && 'IE Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase
        && NOT('IE Transition Status'[from_status] IN StatiDellaFase)
        && 'IE Transition Status'[from_status] <> 'IE Transition Status'[to_status]
    )

VAR usciteIssue =
    FILTER(
        ALL('IE Transition Status'),
        'IE Transition Status'[issue_key] = issueKey
        && 'IE Transition Status'[from_status] IN StatiDellaFase
        && NOT('IE Transition Status'[to_status] IN StatiDellaFase)
        && 'IE Transition Status'[from_status] <> 'IE Transition Status'[to_status]
    )

VAR primaUscitaOpen =
    MINX(usciteIssue, 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date])

VAR giorniOpen =
    VAR primaEntrata = 
        IF(
            NOT ISBLANK(DataCreazioneOpen) && DataCreazioneOpen <= primaUscitaOpen,
            DataCreazioneOpen,
            primaUscitaOpen
        )
    VAR primaSoggiorno =
        IF(
            NOT ISBLANK(primaEntrata) && NOT ISBLANK(primaUscitaOpen) && primaEntrata < primaUscitaOpen,
            DATEDIFF(primaEntrata, primaUscitaOpen, DAY),
            0
        )
    VAR soggiorniSuccessivi =
        SUMX(
            FILTER(
                entrateIssue,
                VAR dataEntrata = 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date]
                RETURN COUNTROWS(
                    FILTER(usciteIssue, 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata)
                ) > 0
            ),
            VAR dataEntrata = 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date]
            VAR primaUscitaSucc =
                MINX(
                    FILTER(usciteIssue, 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata),
                    'IE Transition Status'[transition_date]
                )
            RETURN DATEDIFF(dataEntrata, primaUscitaSucc, DAY)
        )
    RETURN primaSoggiorno + soggiorniSuccessivi

VAR giorniAltriStati =
    SUMX(
        FILTER(
            entrateIssue,
            VAR dataEntrata = 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date]
            RETURN COUNTROWS(
                FILTER(usciteIssue, 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata)
            ) > 0
        ),
        VAR dataEntrata = 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date]
        VAR primaUscita =
            MINX(
                FILTER(usciteIssue, 'IE Transition Status'[transition_date] > dataEntrata),
                'IE Transition Status'[transition_date]
            )
        RETURN DATEDIFF(dataEntrata, primaUscita, DAY)
    )

RETURN
IF(IsOpen, giorniOpen, giorniAltriStati)
